name: CCA 878 乘客心脏病 一发脱离

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 塔台 你准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, ready to taxi.

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, taxi to holding point of runway 08 via taxiway Echo 2 and Alpha.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，经滑行道 Echo 2 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 08 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 08 via taxiway E2 and A, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 E2 和 A 滑行至跑道 08 等待点，CCA878。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, the purser calls you on the intercom, you have a passenger who have become very ill and you must return to the gate, tell air traffic controllers this.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行时，乘务长通过内话呼叫你，有一名旅客病情很重，你必须返回登机口，把这件事告诉空中交通管制员。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, we have a passenger who have become very ill and we have to return to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA878，我们有一名旅客病情很重，必须返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, roger, continue taxi via Alpha, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via Echo, continue to gate 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，收到，继续经 Alpha 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 Echo 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via A, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via E, continue to gate 7, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经 A 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 E 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口，CCA878。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 878, can you tell us the exact problem the passenger has.
B: Tell air traffic control the passenger has suffered a heart attack and you were treating him with oxygen.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 878，能告诉我们旅客的具体问题吗？
B: 告诉空中交通管制，旅客心脏病发作，你们正在给他吸氧。
cards.referenceText: The passenger has suffered a heart attack and we are treating him with oxygen, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该旅客心脏病发作，我们正在给他吸氧，CCA878。

cards.audioText: B: It is now thirty minutes later in the day, the sick passenger has disembarked and you were at the holding point for runway 08, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在是当天 30 分钟后，患病旅客已下机，你在跑道 08 等待点，告诉 塔台 你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA878, hold at holding point runway 08, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA878，在跑道 08 等待点等待，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, line up and wait.
C: Air China 878, hold position for 5 minutes due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，由于流量控制，原地等待 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, after departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, runway 08, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，地面风静风。
cards.referenceText: After departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, runway 08, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，CCA878。

cards.audioText: B: It is now later in the flight and you are experiencing some light turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在飞行后段，你正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA878, we are experiencing light turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA878，我们正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，爬升并保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: B: You reach 10100 meters, but the turbulence is now worse and is now class to severe, ask to climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你到达 10100 米，但颠簸现在更严重，已接近严重，请求爬升到 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA878, request climb to 10700 meters due severe turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA878，因严重颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: 10700 meters not available, we can give you a lower level if you require.
B: Tell the controller you require a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 10700 米不可用，如需要，我们可以给你较低高度。
B: 告诉管制员你需要较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request a lower level, CCA878.

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of your engines separates, tell air traffic control this and say you would like to descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，你的一台发动机脱落，告诉空中交通管制，并说你想下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Sanya Control, CCA878, 1 of our engines separated, request descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，三亚管制，CCA878，我们一台发动机脱落，请求下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，收到 MAYDAY，左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米，CCA878。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, all runway is will be available at Shanghai Pudong for you, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，Shanghai Pudong 所有跑道都将可供你使用，地面风静风。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 878, descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 878，下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET, CCA878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET，CCA878。
